name: repo-mentor
description: Learn how an open-source project works through code-based analysis, a personalized roadmap, independent rebuilding, review, and recorded assessments.

interface.longDescription: Turn a GitHub or local repository into a learning project. RepoMentor guides Codex to inspect real source code, explain architecture and data flow, and design a roadmap around your experience and goals. Choose Guided, Tutor, or Demonstration. Implement core features in a separate directory, review your work, and record understanding, practice, and transfer assessments in local .learning files. Resume from those files or import a LEARNING_BRIEF.md. Codex performs analysis and teaching; bundled Python 3.10+ standard-library helpers only inventory local files and initialize or inspect learning state. Repository access uses your host's available tools. Reference code is read-only by default; running it or installing dependencies requires your confirmation. RepoMentor does not automatically rebuild projects, grade mastery, or move to the next task without your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $repo-mentor 学习一个 GitHub 项目。先分析真实代码并制定路线，等我确认后再开始任务。
使用 $repo-mentor 继续上次的学习，先读取 .learning 文件并核对当前任务。
使用 $repo-mentor 读取 LEARNING_BRIEF.md，验证目标仓库并制定学习路线。
